response: Observed Neotoma pollen fractions on the existing 16 exact-label closed axis; native NISP and outside-axis mass remain visible
nearby_name_join_refused: LandClim SAM is 3.316459 km from Neotoma site 3398; the retained site-identity review does not establish a common physical core or basin, so SAM is excluded as a source join rather than asserted as an alias
training_site_exclusion: Exclude the entire physical site, all target cores, aliases, dataset rows and dependent pollen products from every training and model-selection input
training_population: The 81 previously selected DK/FI/NO physical sites and three previously selected Swedish lake sites, deduplicated by Neotoma site ID
age_model: Sämbosjön source-default comparable calibrated-radiocarbon chronology neotoma:chronology:4262:30017; separate radiocarbon claims are context only
primary_metric: equal-bin mean absolute error on the closed pollen fractions
secondary_metric: equal-bin mean Hellinger distance on the same bins
support_rule: Predict a target bin only when at least two distinct training physical sites have positive closed-axis NISP in that bin; retain every refusal
preparation_read_set: The shared Neotoma prerequisite screen parses the retained observation partitions, including site 3398 target rows, for source validation. Its returned training profiles select DK/FI/NO only; the three Swedish profiles are separately fixed to ABB/BUS/BOKE. No Sämbosjön taxon rows or count composition are selected, aggregated or passed into prepared training, prediction or method choice.
prediction_read_set: target site coordinate, sample and selected age-claim IDs, and candidate bin IDs
scoring_read_set: source-locked Neotoma observation parts and sample-age claims
target_count_use: Target native and closed-axis totals and positive-bin support were inspected for feasibility before protocol declaration. Shared source preparation parses target observation rows but does not select or aggregate them into predictor inputs. Per-taxon target composition and scores were first interpreted after a prediction freeze; subsequent protocol annotation corrections do not change predictions or method choice.
claim_scope: A newly evaluated physical site supplying descriptive observed-pollen development evidence, with prior aggregate-count exposure and later aggregate-score exposure during a protocol annotation correction. No independent-confirmation, untouched-lockbox, LRA, measured-vegetation, basin-buffer or broad Swedish-generalization claim.
